sessions.phase_label: Initial website development and staging review
Production-site refinement and portfolio content integration

requirements.title: Instant Quote Calculator
requirements.definition: An interactive survey-style calculator that selects services, applies square-footage tiers, bundle rules, add-on prices, distance surcharges, and discounts to produce a real-time estimated quote.
requirements.boundary_note: The pricing variables are attributes of one calculation mechanism. This is distinct from the static pricing catalog and the later non-calculating lead-capture form.

requirements.title: Interactive Gallery Browsing
requirements.definition: Visitors can browse and scroll through the image gallery without display or interaction glitches.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers core gallery browsing and the reported gallery glitch; category organization, hover effects, image content, and video content can change independently.

requirements.title: Homepage Hero Blue Overlay
requirements.definition: The homepage hero image uses a subtle blue overlay whose opacity preserves emphasis on the underlying image.
requirements.boundary_note: Limited to the hero overlay color and opacity rather than the website's overall visual design.

requirements.title: Four Pricing Bundle Presentation
requirements.definition: The pricing presentation provides four distinct bundle or package spaces.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the number and presentation of package cards, not the tiered prices within each package.

requirements.title: Detailed Pricing Navigation
requirements.definition: The summary pricing area provides a button or section leading visitors to more detailed pricing information.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the navigation behavior leading to detailed pricing, separate from the pricing information displayed at the destination.

requirements.title: Portfolio Hover Animations
requirements.definition: Portfolio and gallery items use subtle hover animation effects, with the retained behavior applying to both desktop and mobile under the selected implementation.
requirements.boundary_note: Hover behavior is independently configurable and was separately reconsidered for mobile, so it remains distinct from core gallery browsing.

requirements.title: Service-Specific Page Imagery
requirements.definition: Each listed service is accompanied by relevant imagery illustrating that service, such as photos, twilights, floor plans, video, or 3D work.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers semantic correspondence between services and images, not the broader replacement of stock assets or the homepage hero selection.

requirements.title: One-Time Pricing Presentation
requirements.definition: The pricing page presents one-time service prices and does not display monthly or annual pricing tabs.
requirements.boundary_note: The billing-period presentation can change independently from bundle count, tier values, and individual-service details.

requirements.title: Individual Service Price Breakdown
requirements.definition: The pricing page transparently lists individual services and their categorized prices so customers can understand the breakdown and select items outside bundles.
requirements.boundary_note: Individual à-la-carte pricing is independently useful and editable apart from package-card pricing.

requirements.title: Gallery Category Filters
requirements.definition: The gallery is organized into the requested category tabs for photos, twilights, videos, floor plans, and 3D tours, with provision for other photography.
requirements.boundary_note: Category taxonomy is an independently editable organization behavior rather than part of hover animation or gallery rendering stability.

requirements.title: Square-Footage Bundle Pricing
requirements.definition: Each of the four static packages displays different predefined prices for under 1000, 1001–2000, 2001–3000, and 3000-plus square-foot tiers.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a static tiered package display, not the deferred calculator that computes arbitrary quotes from user input.

requirements.title: Mobile Pricing Table Layout
requirements.definition: The pricing table remains readable on mobile using the client-accepted horizontal scrolling approach unless later changed.
requirements.boundary_note: Mobile table layout has its own alternatives and client decision, independent of the prices and package definitions displayed in the table.

requirements.title: Homepage Section Button Links
requirements.definition: Homepage buttons navigate to their corresponding Gallery, Pricing, and Services pages rather than returning to the top of the homepage.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the three section CTA buttons; portfolio-tile links and the Book a Session destination have separate targets and trajectories.

requirements.title: Gallery Portfolio Image Content
requirements.definition: The gallery is populated with the client's supplied portfolio photography rather than placeholder imagery.
requirements.boundary_note: The gallery's content assets can be updated independently from gallery browsing behavior, categories, and animations.

requirements.title: Client-Supplied Website Imagery
requirements.definition: Stock or placeholder images outside the gallery are replaced with suitable images from the client's supplied portfolio.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the source policy for general site imagery; service-to-image correspondence and the specific homepage hero subject are separate constraints.

requirements.title: Homepage Hero House Image
requirements.definition: The primary homepage image depicts a house.
requirements.boundary_note: The required subject of the hero image is independently editable from the overlay treatment and broader stock-image replacement.

requirements.title: Homepage Portfolio Tile Links
requirements.definition: Portfolio tiles on the homepage link visitors to the gallery.
requirements.boundary_note: Portfolio tiles are distinct interactive elements from the homepage Gallery, Pricing, and Services CTA buttons.

requirements.title: Homepage Portfolio Video
requirements.definition: A portfolio video is integrated near the homepage portfolio images when required, with its homepage placement independently removable.
requirements.boundary_note: Homepage video placement is separate because the client later removes it while retaining the same video in the gallery.

requirements.title: Gallery Portfolio Video
requirements.definition: Portfolio video content is integrated into the gallery alongside the pictures rather than isolated in a separate tab.
requirements.boundary_note: Gallery video has a distinct placement decision and remains required after the homepage copy is removed.

requirements.title: Book a Session Button Destination
requirements.definition: The Book a Session button leads visitors to the selected quote or contact workflow rather than having an unresolved destination.
requirements.boundary_note: The button's navigation behavior is independently testable from the fields and styling of the destination form.

requirements.title: Quote Request Form
requirements.definition: A dedicated Get a Quote page provides a form collecting name, optional company, phone number, email, and job description without a Calendly scheduling link.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a simple lead-capture form and not the deferred instant calculator; field schema and absence of scheduling integration are attributes of this form mechanism.

requirements.title: Brand-Consistent Quote Form Styling
requirements.definition: The quote page and form match the existing website's brand guidelines, including layout, typography, colors, and buttons.
requirements.boundary_note: Visual consistency can be changed or approved independently from the form's field schema and submission behavior.

unresolved_candidates.description: The early reference to existing booking functionality is not concrete enough to determine whether it was a separate scheduling Requirement, a generic booking CTA, or an antecedent of the later quote-form workflow.
The recorded gallery-glitch clip is unavailable in the supplied evidence, so the exact failure mode and whether it warrants a narrower Requirement cannot be determined.
